statement.zh: Creamer 等 2013：2003–04 在福塔莱萨谷六处遗址试掘，报告 80 个碳十四样本，占用落入晚古风约 3000–1800 BC。
statement.en: Creamer et al. 2013: 2003–04 testing at six Fortaleza Valley sites reports 80 radiocarbon samples with occupations in Late Archaic ~3000–1800 BC.
